name: Vessa Orrin
summary: A guild factor from the coast who arrived two days ago asking about the convoy.
personality: Smooth, curious, always counting the room.
background: Works for the Caravan Guild's coastal office and does not say what it wants.
appearance: Neat travelling clothes, no dust on them, a signet ring.

speech.style: Courteous, warm on the surface, careful with details.
examples: Surely we can come to terms.

start.public_state: Sitting at the edge of the yard.
start.inner_state: Has been told to find out who opened the well.
